title: Carving a high-speed exit fork out of a straight freeway
change: Opens a two-lane right off-ramp around a raised triangular concrete gore island with V-stripes, chevrons, and exit arrows; ego smoothly commits to the exit fork.
why: High-speed diverge gores trigger late-commit swerves and map-mismatch disengagements; editing both static geometry and ego path tests clean exit execution.
